items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: I was going to make a record with Benny Goodman but I was so scared I couldn't get the words together.

ctx.x: Or you... You must have sung with them at some point, though.
Oh, yeah, I used to sing with them years ago. I was going to make a record with Benny Goodman but I was so scared I couldn't get the words together.
